world_spec.objective: joint survival of all three entities after step 12
world_spec.initial_reserves: iid U(1.0, 13.0) per entity per episode; episodes independent
world_spec.supply: s_i(t) ~ N(mu_i(A, t), 0.35^2), NOT clipped; negative supply allowed and audited
world_spec.supply_mean: mu_i(A,t) = mean_supply + imbalance * season(t) * sign_i(A) (+ entity3_mean_offset for i=3); season(t) = +1 for steps 1..6, -1 for steps 7..12; sign(A=0) = base_signs; A=1 multiplies the signs of entities 1 and 2 by (1 - 2*flip_amplitude) (amplitude 1 = full flip)

2->3.delay: C=0: 6.0 always; C=1: 0.0 if cue1 = 1 (aligned, fast) else 6.0

world_spec.reverse_transfers: use the same channel (efficiency, delay) as the forward direction: one physical pipe per pair
world_spec.transfer_amount: sent = min(3.0, donor reserve); loss (1-e)*sent booked at departure
world_spec.timing: transfer departs before step 1; a delay d = k + f delivers (1-f) of the delivered amount before the supply of step k+1 and f one step later (integer delays reproduce the persistence convention; d >= 12 never arrives)
world_spec.step_order: arrivals -> supply -> clip at capacity (overflow booked) -> maintenance min(max(stock,0), 2) -> failure check (reserve <= 1e-10)
world_spec.failure: irreversible; physics continues after failure for accounting only (a failed entity still receives supply/arrivals)
world_spec.probe: external 0.3 units per channel per step injected at the channel entry, loss (1-e) at injection, travels with the channel's delay (split rule as transfers), measured at the outlet and discharged to an external sink: it NEVER enters a reserve, so probe level does not change survival or optimal actions

probe_start.episode: channel empty at t=0: probe arrivals start after the delay (onset reveals delay)
probe_start.steady: probe flow already running before the episode: arrivals are .3e every step (delay invisible to the probe)

probe_levels.active: probes off (channel sensors read pure noise)

world_spec.observations_decision_time: exact reserves (3) + 3-bit cue (iid uniform); cue bit 1 matters only when C=1; bits 2,3 are distractors
world_spec.observations_post_episode: supply sensors y = s + N(0,0.1^2) per entity per step; probe sensors y = probe arrivals + N(0,0.1^2) per channel per step (the agent's own transfer is NOT sensed); failure step (1..12) or survival per entity; mid-episode reserves are not observed
world_spec.contexts: c = 4A + 2B + C; A: seasonality of entities 1,2 flipped; B: channel 1->2 efficiency lowered by b_gap; C: channel 2<->3 delay fast (d23_fast) only when C=1 and cue1 = 1, otherwise d23_fast + c_delta

settings.behaviour_policy: myopic I with 50/50 belief over the pair (argmax of the mean of the two selection tables)
settings.separability_metric_for_grading: pair-averaged mean episodes for a pair-restricted myopic I to reach posterior .95 from 50/50
settings.relevance_metric_for_grading: pair-averaged cross-context policy regret (both directions averaged), selection/scoring on independent draws
settings.proposal_rule: per passive probe-start variant: smallest dial whose pair-averaged grade equals the target cell; prefer 'episode' if both targets reached there, else 'steady'
